coordinates: WGS84 converted to centered local meters, north is negative Z, values rounded to centimeters
variants: Community reference; no racing-season accuracy or heights inferred. 2026 Bahrain GP in Malaysia maps to Sepang, 2027 Bahrain maps to Sakhir.
upstream_provenance: README acknowledges an initial Google My Maps circuit collection. No Google tiles, imagery, mesh or street-view assets are included. The repository distributes these vector outlines under MIT; this is not an official or surveyed venue source.
